item.title: You're It (SCP concept)
item.content:encoded:
An affliction that causes individuals to attack others and pass on the affliction to survivors of the attacks. Those affected by this SCP will cease to be afflicted after passing it on.

I moved and trimmed your thread summary, since it was taking up extra space in the main forum screen. Try to keep thread descriptions (the text in the little box under the thread title) and titles short so you don't crowd out other authors in the forum listing. ~Zyn

This SCP is a phenomenon that causes afflicted individuals to quickly become more hostile and violent towards others, as well as giving them increased physical strength and resistance to injury. The exact cause of this is unknown, as no pathogen or other potential source has yet to be identified. This SCP will likely cause affected individuals to attack nearby people, often resulting in their deaths. Those who survive these attacks will begin to exhibit the same anomalous effects as their attacker, while the attacker will slowly lose the aggression and increased strength.

Those that have "passed on" the SCP have a moderate chance to die of multiple organ failure after the effects have subsided, and those that live retain memories of their actions while under the influence of this SCP. Should the current carrier of this SCP die before passing it on, it will instead be passed on to the carrier's killer. If the carrier was not killed by a sapient being, the SCP will instead pass on to a random individual, where nearer individuals are more likely to be afflicted.

This SCP is contained via an afflicted D-Class personnel inside a reinforced concrete humanoid containment chamber. The D-Class is kept alive as long as possible, and their vitals are constantly monitored. Additional D-Class personnel are introduced into the chamber to allow the SCP to be passed on. The previous carrier will be tranquilized via remotely controlled sentries before they can kill the new carrier. The previous carrier, now sedated, is removed from the chamber and amnestics are administered.
